name: cortadel-memory
description: Ambient Cortadel memory: push-recall on every prompt, session bootstrap, auto-capture on stop.

base_url.title: Cortadel server URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your self-hosted Cortadel server, e.g. http://localhost:3001 — no trailing slash.

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: The user id your API key was minted for. Must be URL-safe (it is a path segment in the MCP URL) and must match the key's user, or the server responds 403.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: API key for your user. Mint one on the server with: dotnet Cortadel.Api.dll mint-key <user>.

client_name.title: Client name
client_name.description: Label for this client. Becomes the {clientName} path segment of the MCP endpoint and the app_name recorded on memories the hooks capture, so the hooks and the MCP server agree on the app label.
